title: Easy Snappy German Ladyfingers Casserole
description: A kid-friendly German dish featuring savoiardi ladyfingers in a briny and snappy nimono simmer, cooked on a cedar plank for a unique flavor.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Soak the cedar plank in water for 30 minutes.
In a large bowl, whisk together the chicken broth, caraway seeds, thyme, pepper, and salt.
Add the dried ladyfingers to the bowl and let them soak for 10 minutes.
Butter the soaked cedar plank and arrange the soaked ladyfingers on it.
Sprinkle the grated cheddar cheese over the ladyfingers.
Place the cedar plank in the oven and bake for 20 minutes.
Remove the plank from the oven and let it cool for 5 minutes.
Serve the casserole hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley if desired.
Cook poultry to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F before serving.
